name: Needlework of the World
subtitle: Kasuti, Zardozi & more
shortDescription: 6 embroidery and needlework traditions to play: Kasuti, Kutch chain stitch and mirror work, Zardozi gold-wire embroidery and Chamba rumal embroidery.
longDescription:
Needlework of the World: 6 embroidery and needlework traditions from across India, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Kasuti, Kutch chain stitch and mirror work, Zardozi gold-wire embroidery, Chamba rumal embroidery, Lambani patchwork embroidery and Pipili appliqué.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can count threads, stitch mirror and metal-wire work, sew appliqué and match each traditional pattern on the frame, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
